task.description:
Write test specs and tests for SCH-05 — Missed timer recovery.

SCH-05 extends the existing SCH-02 scheduler polling to detect overdue timers and mark them with `fired_late: true` in the TIMER_FIRED event payload.

Write test cases covering:
1. Startup sweep: first poll after init fires all due (fires_at <= NOW()) timers with fired_late=true
2. Normal poll: timers due within poll_interval are NOT marked late; timers overdue by >1 poll interval ARE marked late
3. Extended payload: verify TIMER_FIRED event contains fired_late, scheduled_fire_at, actual_fire_at
4. is_startup_sweep flag transitions from true to false after first pollDueTimers call
5. No timer is skipped (all due timers processed)
6. Cancelled timers (status=CANCELLED) are skipped even if fires_at <= NOW()
7. Integration test: simulate crash/restart by inserting a timer with fires_at in the past, then running pollDueTimers

Write to:
- tests/specs/SCH-05.md (test spec)
- tests/unit/sch05_missed_timer_recovery_test.zig (unit tests)
- tests/integration/sch05_missed_timer_recovery_test.zig (integration tests, optional if existing SCH-02 test file can be extended)

Acceptance criteria:
- Test spec covers all acceptance criteria from SCH-05 requirement
- Unit tests can run without DB
- Integration tests use existing test harness
- zig build test exits 0
acceptance_criteria: tests/specs/SCH-05.md written with full test plan
Unit tests exist in tests/unit/ or tests/integration/

result.summary: Test specs and test code for SCH-05 — Missed timer recovery. Created test spec (tests/specs/SCH-05.md), unit test file (tests/unit/sch05_missed_timer_recovery_test.zig), inline test blocks in src/scheduler/scheduler.zig for pure function coverage, and integration tests in tests/integration/sch02_timer_polling_test.zig. Added build target in build.zig. zig build and zig build test both exit 0.
